issue_request: FHIR-3833 is a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Administration change request asking that Appointment.status be required because an empty status would be difficult to interpret; a Jira comment also suggested status should be must-understand like other status elements.
initial_application: Git commit b34723ee6aa44a8e203b957394d89990759140a9 explicitly named Tracker 3833 and changed Appointment.status cardinality from 0..1 to 1..1 in the old appointment-spreadsheet.xml source. The same historical commit also bundled FHIR-3462 Appointment status code refinements and FHIR-3832 patient search-parameter work.
additional_context: Appointment is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The current authoritative source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml definition for Appointment.status has min=1, max=1, isModifier=true, and a required binding to AppointmentStatus. Later FHIR-55287 and PA minutes record a separate 2026 Resolved-change-required decision to add an unknown AppointmentStatus code as an escape valve for the required binding; that later terminology follow-up does not reverse the FHIR-3833 mandatory cardinality and was not in this default Applied/Published source-edit scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active Appointment source already implements the requested mandatory status cardinality and preserves the related status-modifier behavior.
